summary.text: Paul Cutler is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives who has represented District 18 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. An engineering director by profession, he previously served as mayor of Centerville.

paragraphs.text: Paul Cutler was born in London, England, and lives in Utah, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a BSEE in electrical engineering from the University of Utah in 1997 and an MBA from Brigham Young University in 2003.
His career experience includes work as an engineering director at Cisco and as a wireless systems engineer at Ericsson.
Cutler served on the Centerville City Council and as mayor, and he was on the board of directors of the Utah Telecommunications Open Infrastructure Agency (UTOPIA).
He assumed office in the Utah House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Timothy Hawkes, and the Republican primary for his seat on June 23, 2026, was canceled.
